basic.name: Globe of Annihilation
basic.description:
Shoot a globe of destruction, dealing 176~~0.04~~ damage on impact.  Deals 50% damage to non-Heroes.

Quest: Hitting a Hero or killing a Minion within 3 seconds of being hit by Globe Of Annihilation grants 2 stacks of Annihilation.  Each stack increases its damage by 1. 

Mythic Reward: After gaining 450 Annihilation, the area of Globe of Annihilation is increased by 15% and it deals 150 additional damage.

basic.name: Summon Demon Warrior
basic.description:
Spawn a Demon Warrior that marches forward. Warriors deal 53~~0.04~~ damage per Attack. Loses Health over 17 seconds. Deals 100% bonus damage to Minions and Mercenaries.

Usable while Channeling All Shall Burn.

basic.name: All Shall Burn
basic.description:
Channel a beam of death on an enemy, dealing 128~~0.04~~ damage per second for 2.5 seconds. If the Channel lasts its full duration, deal an extra 340~~0.04~~ damage to the target.

Azmodan's Movement Speed is reduced by 30% while Channeling.

heroic.name: Demonic Invasion
heroic.description:
Rain a small army of Demonic Grunts down on enemies, dealing 85~~0.04~~ damage per impact. Grunts deal 30~~0.04~~ damage, have 750~~0.04~~ Health and last up to 20 seconds. When Grunts die they explode, dealing 40~~0.04~~ damage to nearby enemies, doubled against enemy Heroes.

Usable while Channeling All Shall Burn.

heroic.name: Tide of Sin
heroic.description:
Activate to make the next Globe of Annihilation cost no Mana and deal 50% more damage.

Usable while Channeling All Shall Burn.

heroic.name: Tide of Sin
heroic.description: Your next Globe of Annihilation costs no Mana and deals 50% more damage.

trait.name: Demon Lieutenant
trait.description:
Summon a Demon Lieutenant at any allied Mercenary, Minion, or Azmodan Demon. The Lieutenant will cast Demonic Smite every 7 seconds, instantly killing an enemy Minion. Loses Health over 21 seconds.

Usable while Channeling All Shall Burn.

activable.name: Trample
activable.description:
Activate to charge a short distance, dealing 275~~0.04~~ damage and Slowing enemies caught in the path by 60% for 1.25 second.

After hitting an enemy Hero with Trample, reduce the cooldown of Azmodan's Heroic Ability by 25%.

level1.name: Greed
level1.description:
Globe of Annihilation deals 15% more damage to non-Heroic targets.

Quest: After gaining 225 Annihilation, increase the range of All Shall Burn by 25% and Demon Warriors gain 20% Attack Speed and Movement Speed. Globe of Annihilation's damage penalty against Minions and Mercenaries is removed.

level1.name: Gluttony
level1.description:
Increase the number of stacks of Annihilation gained by hitting Heroes with Globe of Annihilation from 2 to 4.

Quest: After gaining 225 Annihilation, each enemy hit by Globe of Annihilation reduces its cooldown by 0.25 seconds, doubled against Heroes. Globe of Annihilation's damage penalty against Minions and Mercenaries is removed.

level1.name: Wrath
level1.description:
Every other Basic Attack against Heroes or Structures grant Annihilation. 

Quest: After gaining 225 Annihilation, hitting a Hero with Globe of Annihilation increases the damage of Azmodan's next Basic Attack against them within 3 seconds by 85% the amount of Annihilation he has. Globe of Annihilation's damage penalty against Minions and Mercenaries is removed.

level4.name: Army of Hell
level4.description: Summon Demon Warrior spawns an additional Demon, but its cooldown is increased by 10 seconds.

level4.name: Hellforged Armor
level4.description: Demon Warriors and Lieutenants gain 20 Armor and lose 25% less health per second.

level4.name: Battleborn
level4.description: Reduce the Mana cost of Summon Demon Warrior from 25 to 20. Azmodan's Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Summon Demon Warrior by 0.75 seconds and Demon Lieutenant by 1.5 seconds.

level7.name: Art of Chaos
level7.description: If Globe of Annihilation hits 2 or more Heroes, restore 40 Mana and gain an extra 2 Annihilation.

level7.name: Bombardment
level7.description: After casting Globe of Annihilation, Azmodan's Basic Attacks within the next 3 seconds have an additional 1.5 range and can hit 3 additional targets. Hitting Heroes with Basic Attacks empowered by Bombardment grant 1 Annihilation.

level7.name: Master of Destruction
level7.description: If All Shall Burn's Channel kills or lasts its full duration, All Shall Burn's final damage applies to all enemies in an area around the target and grants 1 Annihilation per Hero hit.

level10.name: Demonic Invasion
level10.description:
Rain a small army of Demonic Grunts down on enemies, dealing 85~~0.04~~ damage per impact. Grunts deal 30~~0.04~~ damage, have 750~~0.04~~ Health and last up to 20 seconds. When Grunts die they explode, dealing 40~~0.04~~ damage to nearby enemies, doubled against enemy Heroes.

Usable while Channeling All Shall Burn.

level10.name: Tide of Sin
level10.description:
Activate to make the next Globe of Annihilation cost no Mana and deal 50% more damage.

Usable while Channeling All Shall Burn.

level13.name: Brutish Vanguard
level13.description: Demon Warriors and Lieutenants gain 25% increased Health. Demon Warriors Slow attacked targets by 30%.

level13.name: Cydaea's Kiss
level13.description: Reduces the Channel time of All Shall Burn by 0.5 seconds. If All Shall Burn's Channel kills or lasts its full duration against a Hero, Azmodan is healed for 8% of his maximum Health.

level13.name: Chain of Command
level13.description: The cooldown of Demon Lieutenants' Demonic Smite is reduced by 2 seconds and they grant 25% increased damage to nearby friendly Minions, Mercenaries, and Azmodan's summoned Demons.

level16.name: Total Annihilation
level16.description: Globe of Annihilation damages Heroes for an additional 4% of their maximum Health.

level16.name: Hell Rift
level16.description: If All Shall Burn Channels for its full duration or kills the target, a Demon Warrior is summoned at the target's location and all Demon Warriors deal 35% increased damage for 5 seconds.

level16.name: Trample
level16.description:
Activate to charge a short distance, dealing 275~~0.04~~ damage and Slowing enemies caught in the path by 60% for 1.25 second.

After hitting an enemy Hero with Trample, reduce the cooldown of Azmodan's Heroic Ability by 25%.

level20.name: Siegebreaker
level20.description: Azmodan's Demons deal 40% increased damage to Structures.

level20.name: Black Pool
level20.description: Globes of Annihilation empowered by Tide of Sin also leave a Black Pool at their impact location for 5 seconds. Enemies within the pool lose 8 Armor per second, up to 15, and take 56~~0.04~~ damage per second.

level20.name: Inescapable Annihilation
level20.description: Globe of Annihilation can now be cast globally.

level20.name: Sin's Grasp
level20.description:
All Shall Burn Slows enemy Heroes. While active, the target is Slowed by 15%, and if it lasts its full duration, they are Slowed by 50% for 2.5 seconds.

If All Shall Burn's Channel kills or lasts its full duration against a Hero, reduce its cooldown by 50%.
